To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
(1) the temporal pyramid is a useful representation for ADL recognition and (2) the composite object model is a useful representation.

1) the proposed temporal pyramid and composite object model representations improve the accuracy of ADL detection by 2-fold, 2) ADL detection accuracy correlates strongly with the number of object interactions in the video, and 3) the proposed temporal pyramids and composite object models are the first methods to exploit long-term temporal structure in ADLs.
(1) temporal pyramid representations and (2) object interaction representations are effective for recognizing ADLs in first-person camera data.
